members.hint: Each person signs in on their own phone with the business code, their username and their PIN. The owner signs in with Google.
members.newHint: Add someone from your team: their name is their username and they sign in to the phone app with their 5-digit PIN. No Google account needed.
members.disableHint: A disabled person cannot sign in, but their history is kept.
members.ownerLocked: Only the owner can change this account
members.nameHint: They sign in with this name: it cannot repeat within the business
members.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.

pin.label: PIN (5 digits)
pin.mustChange: Must change their PIN on first sign-in
pin.once: Write it down or tell them now: for security it is stored encrypted and cannot be shown again. If it is forgotten, set a new one.

devices.revokeBody: “{{name}}” will stop syncing and will need to be linked again.
devices.revokePending_one: It has {{count}} operation not sent yet; it stays on the phone but will not arrive here until it is linked again.
devices.revokePending_other: It has {{count}} operations not sent yet; they stay on the phone but will not arrive here until it is linked again.
devices.linkHint: On the new phone open the app and choose “Link this phone”: it shows a short code. Type it here.
devices.empty: There are no linked phones yet.
devices.note: Each person who signs in with the business code appears here; you can revoke any phone.

accessCode.title: Business code
accessCode.copyFailed: Could not copy: select it and copy it by hand.
accessCode.shareMessage: To join {{business}} in the Cuentiva app: code {{code}}, your username and your PIN.
accessCode.explain: Each person signs in on their own phone with this code, their username (their name) and their PIN. The owner signs in with Google.
accessCode.renewBody: The current code will stop working for new sign-ins: anyone signing in for the first time will need the new code. Phones that are already linked keep working.
accessCode.chooseHint: 5 digits, not starting with 0. Pick one that is easy to remember.
accessCode.chooseFormat: It must be 5 digits and cannot start with 0.
accessCode.chooseBody: The current code will stop working for new sign-ins. Phones that are already linked keep working.
accessCode.taken: That code is already used by another business, try another one
accessCode.invalid: The code must be 5 digits and not start with 0.

created.title: Person created
created.intro: Tell {{name}} what they need to sign in on their phone:
created.message: To join {{business}} in the Cuentiva app: code {{code}}, username {{username}}, PIN {{pin}}.
created.once: The PIN cannot be shown again: write it down or share it now. If it is forgotten, set a new one.
